sources.snippet: Gemma 4 E4B IT — Abliterated This is an abliterated (uncensored) version of google/gemma-4-E4B-it, created using Abliterix. E4B is the Effective 4B member of Google's Gemma 4 family — a multimodal (text + vision + audio) model with ~8B raw parameters.
